_om: Grådigper in English (Nibbles, rusj.no/en/nibbles/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. British English. No casino words: nobody goes ‘bust’ or ‘banks’ – you get ‘two alike’ (the stamp says ‘Snap!’) and you ‘stop and keep’. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Alle har fått ett kort. Ett til – eller: Everyone has a card. One more – or stop?
Nye kort til alle. Ett til – eller stopp: New cards for everyone. One more – or stop?
{navn} fikk {kort} en gang til og mister: {navn} drew a second {kort} and loses this round's points.
{navn} fikk {kort} en gang til – men kin: {navn} drew a second {kort} – but the cheek pouch swallowed it!
{navn} har sju ulike tall! Runden er ove: {navn} has seven different numbers! The round is over, with {n} extra points.
{navn} fikk en kinnpose – den redder ett: {navn} got a cheek pouch – it saves one number that turns up again.
{navn} fikk «Dobbel»: tallkortene teller: {navn} got ‘Double’: the number cards count twice.
Gir like mange poeng som tallet. Det fin: Worth as many points as the number. There are as many of each number as the number itself – and a single zero.
Legges til poengene dine i runden. Seks: Added to your points for the round. Six in the pack.
Tallkortene dine teller dobbelt i denne: Your number cards count twice this round. Only one in the pack.
Redder deg én gang: Får du et tall du ha: Saves you once: draw a number you already have and it vanishes into the pouch. Three in the pack.
Trekk ett kort til – eller stopp mens le: Take one more card – or stop while you're ahead. Draw a number you already have and the round's points are gone. First to 200 wins.
Alle starter runden med ett kort. Når de: Everyone starts the round with one card. On your turn you choose: ‘One more’ for a new card, or ‘Stop’ to keep your points for the round.
To like, og runden ryker: Two alike and the round is gone
Tallkortene gir like mange poeng som tal: Number cards are worth as many points as the number. But draw a number you already have in front of you, and you lose everything you've collected this round.
Sju ulike tall foran deg stopper runden: Seven different numbers in front of you stop the round at once and give 15 extra points. When someone has reached the target at the end of a round, the player with the most points wins.
Høye kort gir mest – men det finnes tolv: High cards are worth the most – but there are twelve 12s and only one 1, so the high ones turn up again most often.
Når noen får sju ulike, beholder alle so: When someone gets seven different, everyone still in keeps their points.
Nullen gir ingen poeng, men teller som e: The zero is worth nothing, but counts as one of the seven.
Har du en kinnpose, kan du våge ett kort: Got a cheek pouch? Then you can risk one more card.
Trykket «Stopp» ved et uhell? «Angre» vi: Tapped ‘Stop’ by accident? ‘Undo’ works until the next player has chosen.
Legg mobilen midt på bordet så alle ser: Put the phone in the middle of the table so everyone can see the cards – or play with a phone each online.
To like, og rundens poeng ryker!: Two alike and it's all gone!
Legg mobilen midt på bordet, så alle ser: Put the phone in the middle of the table, so everyone can see the cards.
Hvor mange poeng dere spiller til: How many points you play to
Det vanlige målet. Tar gjerne et kvarter: The usual target. Takes about a quarter of an hour.
{navn} vant {spill} med {poeng}! Tør du: {navn} won {spill} with {poeng}! Dare you take one more card?
Vi har spilt {spill}. Tør du ta ett kort: We've been playing {spill}. Dare you take one more card?
Først til {mal}. Fet skrift betyr sju ul: First to {mal}. Bold means seven different.
Ingen runde er ferdig ennå. Dere kan all: No round is finished yet. You can always start a new one.
Dere går rett til kåringen med poengene: You go straight to the results with the points from the rounds that are finished.
